stories.title: Gahirmatha seven-month fishing ban (1 November–31 May)
stories.body: Odisha's annual ban to protect Olive Ridley turtles.

stories.title: Tribal Freedom Fighters Museum
stories.body: India's first digital museum on tribal freedom fighters comes up in Chhattisgarh, ahead of the state's 25th foundation day (1 November).
